notes: Hearts & Thunder: love now CONVERTS -- fill a unit's heart with WaveCasters or the Siren and it joins your side (Gods die of heartbreak instead). Every God's ability reworked or sharpened: Hermes dashes, Poseidon fires a water laser, Ares executes, Zeus's chain truly hops and stuns, Hades opens the Gates of the Dead. Medusa petrifies her victim into a statue, Minotaur bull-rushes, shields now work exactly like Clash Royale, every unit winds up before its first swing, and enemy traps are invisible until they spring. Plus a new battle HUD, loading screens, and a boot splash. Measured across 11,000+ duels.
